in_arabic.name: حيدرة
in_arabic.meaning: حيدرة تعني القوة و الشجاعة في اللغة العربية
in_arabic.long_meaning: حيدرة هو اسم مشتق من الجذر العربي 'حيدر' الذي يعني القوة و الشجاعة. يعتبر اسم حيدرة من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني القوة و الإقدام في اللغة العربية و التقاليد الإسلامية. استخدم هذا الاسم في العديد من الثقافات الإسلامية كدلالة على الشجاعة و القوة.

in_urdu.name: حیدرہ
in_urdu.meaning: حیدرہ مطلب ہے طاقت و جرأت
in_urdu.long_meaning: حیدرہ ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے طاقت و جرأت. یہ نام عربی جڑ 'حیدر' سے نکلا ہے جو کہ طاقت و توانائی کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے. جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی روایات میں، یہ نام طاقت، جرأت، اور مردانگی کی علامت کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: हैदराह
in_hindi.meaning: हैदराह का अर्थ है शक्ति और वीरता
in_hindi.long_meaning: हैदराह एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है शक्ति और वीरता. यह नाम अरबी मूल 'हैदर' से निकला है जो शक्ति और साहस को दर्शाता है. भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम शक्ति, साहस, और वीरता के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है.

in_pashto.name: حیدره
in_pashto.meaning: حیدره د قوت او زړورتيا معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: حیدره د عربي نوم څخه مشتق شوی دی چې د قوت او زړورتيا مانا لري. دا نوم د عربي ريښې 'حيدر' څخه اخيستل شوی دی چې د توان او زړورتيا ښودنه کوي. د افغان او پښتون دوديزو کې، دا نوم د زړورتيا، قوت، او مردانگۍ د نښانې په توګه کارول کيږي.

in_english.name: Hyderah
in_english.meaning: Hyderah means power, courage, and strength

The name Hyderah is used across various Muslim cultures to denote these positive attributes and is often chosen for its spiritual significance and cultural importance.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hyderah carries a rich cultural legacy in various Muslim-majority communities. The word "Hyder" in Arabic refers to "garden" or "a place of growth and abundance". Hyderah therefore symbolizes a nurturer, a woman who tends to her garden, and this could be perceived on various levels. Historically, the royal title "Hyder Ali" was awarded to Muslim rulers who brought prosperity and growth to their lands, thus Hyderah would represent such a powerful and significant queen or leader. Culturally, the name Hyderah could be associated with a wife or mother who takes care of her household and family, nurturing her loved ones the same way a farmer tends his crops. It could also be symbolic of a community connected to its roots, who preserves and continues to contribute to its culture, keeping it alive and thriving, much like the beautiful gardens that dot many Muslim lands.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Hyderah embodies the concept of being a caretaker and nurturer. The Islamic identity stresses the importance of stewardship and taking care of Allah's creations, including our communities, families, and environments. The name signifies the role of women as fulfilling this responsibility in nature, by tending to her garden and maintaining its beauty and bounty, and extending it to her Church, Home, and Community. The spiritual symbolism of the name Hyderah can be connected to the role of the Prophet Khadija, the first wife of the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh), who provided sustenance and support for him in his early years and became a source of strength and encouraging motivation for his mission. Thus, Hyderah can be a source of inspiration for women to take on their roles as nurturers, protectors, and caretakers of the home, family, community, and environment.
